universe.rules: US-listed operating companies (SEC ticker list), price >= $5, 20-day $ volume >= $5M, FINRA report <= 35 days old

pass_bar: OOS (2025-latest) net total return > 0 after borrow, OOS Sharpe > 0.5, latest year not negative; hedged also needs OOS Sharpe above SPY

families.title: Short the most-shorted stocks (monthly basket)
families.plain: Each month, short the stocks with the highest days-to-cover (or short % of shares), equal weight. Optional filter: only names already falling (negative 12-month momentum or below the 200-day average).

families.title: Long least-shorted / short most-shorted
families.plain: Each month, 50% of the account long the least-shorted stocks and 50% short the most-shorted ones (the classic days-to-cover spread).

families.title: Short most-shorted basket, hedged with SPY
families.plain: Each month, 50% short the most-shorted basket and 50% long SPY, so a rising market does not sink the shorts.

families.title: Short the failed squeeze
families.plain: Short a heavily shorted stock after it spikes to a new 60-day high and then breaks down: closes 15-25% below the peak and under its 20-day average. Stop above entry, time exit.
families.portfolio_note: 10 equal slots of 10% each; P&L booked in the exit month
